remarks: Welcome to this exceptional 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom residence in Stamford's highly coveted Westover neighborhood, thoughtfully and completely renovated to offer the perfect blend of modern luxury and timeless elegance. Nestled on a private, manicured lot, the property features beautifully lit stone columns, walls and a granite walkway and landing that set the tone for this spacious family retreat. Inside, you're greeted by a dramatic curved staircase with detailed millwork, leading to a large formal living room, dining room and a stunning open-concept kitchen featuring a 9-foot quartz island, 6-burner gas stove, pantry and top-tier appliances. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a warm and inviting family room with a wood-burning fireplace and sliders to the outside, followed by a mudroom and full bathroom. Unique to this home is the generous first-floor primary suite, complete with walk-in closet, a spa-inspired bathroom featuring radiant heated floors, dual vanities and an oversized shower. A large home office with custom built-ins and half bathroom complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find four spacious ensuite bedrooms, as well as a media room with soaring cathedral ceilings and a private balcony overlooking the pool. The recently finished basement includes a fully equipped home gym, expansive recreation area and a custom laundry room with built-in counter and laundry sink. The interior has been freshly painted with custom millwork.
